result.rationale: Distinct regulated transmission opco. Midwest owns 100%; AEP owns 80.1% of Midwest and Olympus 19.9%. KKR and PSP's 50/50 Olympus partnership gives PSP 9.95% look-through. Closed 2025-06-05; no later ownership event found.

identityResolution.canonicalLegalName: AEP Indiana Michigan Transmission Company, Inc.
identityResolution.relationship: AEP -> AEP Transmission Holding Company, LLC -> AEP Transmission Company, LLC (80.1% of Midwest); Olympus BidCo L.P. (19.9%) -> Midwest -> 100% of IMTCo and separate OHTCo.
identityResolution.clarification: The contract's 'AEP Holdco' is AEP Transmission Company, LLC, not AEP Transmission Holding Company, LLC.
identityResolution.boundary: Create IMTCo once; do not merge Indiana Michigan Power, OHTCo, vehicles, projects or assets.

ownershipResolution.vehicleFinding: Olympus BidCo L.P. (GP: Olympus GPCo, LLC) is controlled by the disclosed KKR funds and PSPIB; PSP is a co-investor, not a KKR-fund LP.

operatingResolution.profile: FERC-regulated transmission-only utility in Indiana and Michigan; PJM member; AEP-operated with no IMTCo employees.
operatingResolution.customers: PJM-allocated ratepayers and wholesale/network users, not Indiana Michigan Power retail customers.
operatingResolution.scale: 2025: 1,142 pole-miles on designated structures plus 55 on others, 161 circuits, $2.268bn line cost, 96 substation/equipment rows and 2,822 MVA transmission-substation capacity; 2026 PTRR $552.7m plus $1.1m true-up.
operatingResolution.regulatoryBoundary: FERC rates and IURC/MPSC oversight do not confer equity.
